title: Container runs as root user
description: The image explicitly switches to the root user (UID 0). A process compromise inside the container grants full privileges, dramatically increasing the blast radius of any exploit and simplifying container breakout attempts.
remediation:
RUN addgroup --system app && adduser --system --ingroup app app
USER app

title: Mutable base image tag (:latest)
description: The base image is pulled using the floating ':latest' tag. Builds become non-reproducible, silently inherit upstream breaking changes, and bypass vulnerability review because the actual image content changes over time.
remediation:
FROM node:20.11.1-alpine3.19
# Prefer pinning to an immutable digest for fully reproducible builds:
# FROM node:20.11.1-alpine3.19@sha256:<digest>

title: Sensitive database or cache port exposed
description: The image documents exposure of a database or cache port (MySQL 3306, MongoDB 27017, Redis 6379, PostgreSQL 5432). Application containers should never expose data-store ports; doing so signals a co-located datastore or an unnecessary attack surface on the network.
remediation:
# Expose only the application port and run datastores as separate services
EXPOSE 8080

title: Missing WORKDIR instruction
description: No WORKDIR instruction was found. Without it, RUN, COPY, and CMD instructions execute relative to the filesystem root, which encourages writing application files into '/' and makes path handling fragile and error-prone.

title: Missing HEALTHCHECK instruction
description: No HEALTHCHECK instruction was found. Orchestrators cannot distinguish a hung or deadlocked process from a healthy one, so failing containers keep receiving traffic instead of being restarted or drained.

title: Hard-coded secret in ENV or ARG
description: An ENV or ARG instruction appears to embed a credential (password, token, API key, or private key). Values set this way are baked into image layers and build history, where anyone with pull access can recover them.
remediation:
# Inject secrets at runtime or via BuildKit secret mounts instead of ENV/ARG
RUN --mount=type=secret,id=npm_token \
  NPM_TOKEN=$(cat /run/secrets/npm_token) npm ci

title: ADD used instead of COPY
description: ADD supports remote URL fetching and automatic archive extraction, both of which introduce supply-chain and path-traversal risks. COPY is explicit and predictable for local files.
